sources.name: CNN vs ViT Model Selector
sources.description: Controlled CIFAR-100 benchmark comparing custom residual CNN and Vision Transformer under strictly matched parameter budgets (~960k parameters), measuring clean accuracy, ECE calibration, Gaussian noise degradation, and inference latency across multiple random seeds.

sources.name: CIFAR-10-C Robustness Study
sources.license: Open Research / Not specified in repository (weights Apache-2.0 via timm/HuggingFace)
sources.description: Inference-only robustness evaluation across 19 corruptions and 5 severity levels on CIFAR-10-C comparing ResNet-50, ViT-Base/16, and ConvNeXt-Tiny.

sources.name: Official MViTv2 (Facebook Research)
sources.authors: Haoqi Fan, Yanghao Li, Bo Xiong, Wan-Yen Lo, Christoph Feichtenhofer (Meta AI)
sources.description: Multiscale Vision Transformers v2 for Image Recognition and Video Classification (CVPR 2022). Pretrained checkpoints on ImageNet-1K with multiscale pooling attention mechanism.

sources.name: Benchmarking Neural Network Robustness to Common Corruptions and Perturbations
sources.description: Foundational robustness benchmark defining the standardized 15 corruptions (and 4 extra) across noise, blur, weather, and digital distortions, establishing Mean Corruption Error (mCE) normalized to AlexNet baseline.
